name: devmesh
description: An evidence-based AI software engineering, greenfield website product building, website-operations, and agency-operations orchestration framework with Codex and ChatGPT adapters, Mission Control, full-stack development, WordPress, IDX/MLS/RESO, multi-site operations, QA, and delivery.

interface.shortDescription: AI Website Product Builder + Engineering Mission Control
interface.longDescription: DevMesh v1.2 adds Website Product Builder for explicit greenfield website delivery from requirements through design system, sitemap/information architecture, UI component architecture, frontend, conditional backend/API/database, SEO, QA and deployment. It builds on full-stack engineering, Mission Control, v1.1 Agency Operations, v1.0 Website Operations, WordPress Real Estate, IDX/MLS/RESO, Browser QA, security, accessibility, performance, CI, deployment, incident response, review, memory, reporting, and Git delivery.
defaultPrompt: DevMesh Website Product Builder: build this website from scratch from product contract through design system, sitemap, UI architecture, implementation, SEO, QA, and production delivery.
DevMesh Deep: build a complete working website with professional UI/UX plus backend, API, database and integrations only where the product actually requires them.
DevMesh Agency Deep: audit all client websites, prioritize incidents and maintenance, and create a site-specific action queue with evidence.
